title: ECMWF IFS: the medium-range forecast of ECMWF's Integrated Forecasting System, near the surface and aloft
provider: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF); open data of the IFS medium-range forecast (stream oper, formerly HRES) at 0.25°, from data.ecmwf.int
credit: ECMWF IFS (CC BY 4.0): based on data and products of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF); sampled to 1°

mirrors.dataset: the copy on Amazon S3 (registry.opendata.aws/ecmwf-forecasts), in the same layout

variables.name: mtpr
variables.long_name: Precipitation rate, mean over the {interval} h before

cycle.description: The run taken is the latest at 00 or 12 UTC, at or before this time (UTC), whose files reach the last step; ECMWF keeps the last 12 runs (about three days)

hours.description: Last step, in hours after the run

step_hours.description: Hours between steps: a multiple of 3 to 144 h, of 6 beyond

stride.description: Take every n-th point of the 0.25° grid when the product is built: 4 gives 1°, 8 gives 2° (the files hold the whole grid)

forecast.description: The latest run to five days ahead, every 6 h: 11 fields at 21 steps, about 120 MB of GRIB2; a 1° product

glance.description: The latest run to two days ahead, every 12 h: about 30 MB of GRIB2; a 2° product

format: GRIB2 with CCSDS packing, one file per step holding the selected messages in the order of the source file: msl (Pa); 2t (K); 10u, 10v (m s-1); tp (m of water equivalent, accumulated from the start of the run); t at 850 hPa (K); gh at 500 hPa (geopotential metres); u, v at 500 and 250 hPa (m s-1). Grid 0.25°, 1440 x 721, latitude 90° to −90°, longitude −180° to 179.75°. Decoded with ecCodes by data/products/ecmwf_fields.py.
coverage: Global; runs at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC (00 and 12 UTC: every 3 h to 144 h, every 6 h to 360 h; 06 and 18 UTC: every 3 h to 144 h); about 7 h after the run for the 0.25° files; the last 12 runs are kept
